name: go-snap-tests
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/extract/go-setup.sh && export GDP_GO_SNAPSHOT=/tmp/snap-tests.jsonl && (cd core && bun test extract-go.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -5); echo '--- snapshot'; cat /tmp/snap-tests.jsonl

name: go-snap-realworld
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/extract/go-setup.sh && export GDP_GO_SNAPSHOT=/tmp/snap-rw.jsonl && timeout -s KILL 2400 bun research/extract/go-run.ts --out /tmp/xg 2>&1 | tail -3; echo '--- results'; cat /tmp/xg/results.jsonl; echo '--- snapshot'; cat /tmp/snap-rw.jsonl

name: rust
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && . research/langs/rust/rust-setup.sh && (cd core && timeout -s KILL 900 bun test --timeout 600000 extract-rs.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -15); timeout -s KILL 1200 bun research/langs/rust/run.ts --ms 60000 --write --json /tmp/rs.json 2>&1 | tail -60; echo '--- json'; cat /tmp/rs.json; for f in research/langs/rust/rules/*.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done

name: litellm-py
cmd: set -o pipefail; cd /tmp && git clone -q --depth 1 --branch ${LITELLM_REF:-v1.106.6} ${LITELLM_REPO:-https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm} litellm && cd litellm && git rev-parse HEAD && pip install -q uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout -s KILL 600 uv pip install --system -q -e '.[proxy]' 2>&1 | tail -5; python3 -c 'import litellm.proxy.auth.auth_checks' && cd /work/gdp-wired && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout -s KILL 1200 bun research/langs/litellm/run.ts --src /tmp/litellm --ms 60000 --write --json /tmp/litellm-py.json; echo '--- json'; cat /tmp/litellm-py.json; for f in research/langs/litellm/rules/*.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done
